gloss: swimming stroke; swimming style; swimming technique

definitions.gloss: swimming stroke; swimming style; swimming technique
definitions.explanation: The technique or style of swimming, particularly in the context of competitive or instructional swimming. The four standard competitive strokes are freestyle, backstroke, breaststroke, and butterfly.

examples.japanese: {四|よん}つの{泳法|えいほう}を{習|なら}う。
{平泳|ひらおよ}ぎは{最|もっと}も{古|ふる}い{泳法|えいほう}の{一|ひと}つだ。
examples.english: The breaststroke is one of the oldest swimming strokes.

examples.japanese: {大会|たいかい}では{四|よん}つの{泳法|えいほう}を{順番|じゅんばん}に{泳|およ}ぐメドレーリレーが{一番|いちばん}{盛|も}り{上|あ}がる。
examples.english: At competitions, the medley relay where swimmers use all four strokes in order is the most exciting event.

notes:
Refers to the technique or style of swimming. In competitive swimming, the four standard strokes are {自由形|じゆうがた} (freestyle/crawl), {背泳|せおよ}ぎ (backstroke), {平泳|ひらおよ}ぎ (breaststroke), and バタフライ (butterfly).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {四|よん}{泳法|えいほう}: the four swimming strokes
- {泳法|えいほう}を{身|み}につける: to master a swimming stroke
- {泳法|えいほう}を{変|か}える: to change swimming style
- {基本|きほん}{泳法|えいほう}: basic swimming stroke

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {水泳|すいえい}: swimming — the activity itself, not the technique
- {泳|およ}ぎ{方|かた}: way of swimming — more casual, everyday expression for swimming style
